title: MZ How can I add new blend modes to Galv's "Layers Graphics" plugin?

posts.author: Fcrlovem
posts.body:
The other day working in clip studio paint, we achieved a beautiful effect for the map illuminations.
I have tried to make it look the same in the game using the Galv Layers Graphics plugin but in clip studio we have used blending modes that the plugin doesn't have, these would be "Soft Light" and "Glow Dodge".
I'm looking for someone who can help me solve or achieve this please help .
Thank you all so much for being part of this community .

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
According to pixi.js it seems only a few a supported in webGL mode.
You'll need to change to canvas mode to use most of them.
JavaScript:
/**
 * Various blend modes supported by PIXI.
 *
 * IMPORTANT - The WebGL renderer only supports the NORMAL, ADD, MULTIPLY and SCREEN blend modes.
 * Anything else will silently act like NORMAL.
 *
 * @static
 * @constant
 * @memberof PIXI
 * @name BLEND_MODES
 * @type {object}
 * @property {number} NORMAL
 * @property {number} ADD
 * @property {number} MULTIPLY
 * @property {number} SCREEN
 * @property {number} OVERLAY
 * @property {number} DARKEN
 * @property {number} LIGHTEN
 * @property {number} COLOR_DODGE
 * @property {number} COLOR_BURN
 * @property {number} HARD_LIGHT
 * @property {number} SOFT_LIGHT
 * @property {number} DIFFERENCE
 * @property {number} EXCLUSION
 * @property {number} HUE
 * @property {number} SATURATION
 * @property {number} COLOR
 * @property {number} LUMINOSITY
 */
var BLEND_MODES = exports.BLEND_MODES = {
  NORMAL: 0,
  ADD: 1,
  MULTIPLY: 2,
  SCREEN: 3,
  OVERLAY: 4,
  DARKEN: 5,
  LIGHTEN: 6,
  COLOR_DODGE: 7,
  COLOR_BURN: 8,
  HARD_LIGHT: 9,
  SOFT_LIGHT: 10,
  DIFFERENCE: 11,
  EXCLUSION: 12,
  HUE: 13,
  SATURATION: 14,
  COLOR: 15,
  LUMINOSITY: 16,
  NORMAL_NPM: 17,
  ADD_NPM: 18,
  SCREEN_NPM: 19
};

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
There should be a plugin called Community basic that allows you to change that.
Or you can edit package.json and add canvas behind html
"main": "index.html?canvas",

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Ah, maybe RMMZ removed canvas mode?
Edit*
Yeah, it seems like that. I recall RMMZ uses a different animation format that can only be loaded using webGL.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
The best bet is try to implement them using shaders and filters. However I don't think there is a plugin made for MZ yet.
There is an implement for example, but not a RPGmaker plugin. :/
GitHub - pixijs-userland/picture: A plugin that includes a sprite renderer that reduces border artifacts and 3 blend mode implementations for WebGL
